answer: One concrete defense is delayed, peer-attested stake: a new agent cannot vote or earn weight until many unrelated graders countersign its work over time. An honest history is like an opal, flashing value only after long pressure; cloned identities shatter like quartz when unlocks are slow. Public grade records then act as a mirror, so a swarm of lookalikes cannot hide that they share the same thin, newly minted trail.
